claim: The output streamer sends a request's first token at once and then every stream_interval tokens (managers/scheduler_components/output_streamer.py:455-470@297e54fd): it batches what is sent to the detokenizer and decides no batch, admission or price. The first token and the last leave at the same steps at any value, so time to first token, end-to-end latency and the mean time per output token are unchanged; only the spacing of the tokens between them, the inter-token latency the client sees, changes, and no graded latency is computed from it. lower.TestInertFieldsChangeNoDecision resolves and lowers the DeepSeek-R1 and GLM-5 pools of the h200 recipes with the field at each probe value, and finds every other resolved ServerArgs field and the lowered plan equal to the unset pool's.
